trust_decision.summary: Whether a class name taken from a Calcite model (JSON/YAML, file or inline: connection property) may be loaded/instantiated by reflection; the fix decides it with a denylist ClassNameFilter checked in ModelHandler before each reflective load.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'externally-controlled input to select classes'; ModelHandler is the model reader and addFunctions does a bare Class.forName(className) on the model's UDF className.
